trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' OR p.birth_date = '1973-11-25' OR p.birth_date = 'November 25, 1973' OR p.birth_date = 'November 25 1973' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player
